_comment: Canonical business/service-area context for the Site Improvement Agent. Single maintainable source of truth — see agent/lib/business-profile.js for the loader and agent/README.md's 'Canonical business context' section for how this is used and kept honest. Every fact below was read directly off the live site (index.html's JSON-LD + #service-areas section) or agent/lib/page-groups.js at verification time — nothing here is invented. Update this file (and re-verify against the live site) if the business's real services/area/identity change; do not let a second copy of this data grow anywhere else in the agent.

sources: agent/lib/page-groups.js (which city/service pages actually exist, pre-existing single source for the audits)

services._specialtyPagesNote: These real pages exist and serve real audiences but deliberately are not modeled as one of the ten general 'item removed' service pages above (page-groups.js's long-standing reasoning, preserved as-is): hoa-junk-removal.html, commercial-junk-removal.html, office-junk-removal.html, contractor-remodeler-junk-removal.html, property-management-junk-removal.html, same-day-junk-removal.html. The agent should not assume every audit that iterates `services.pages` also needs to cover these.

serviceArea._note: Two distinct lists on purpose. 'citiesWithPages' is what the site can actually show a visitor today (file = `${slug}-junk-removal.html`). 'claimedCitiesWithoutPages' is real: index.html's own JSON-LD areaServed and the homepage's service-areas section both claim these cities too ('+ all surrounding areas'), but none has a dedicated page. That gap is evidence for the weekly research rotation to evaluate — NOT a to-do list of pages to auto-create (see agent/README.md's new-page standard: a page needs its own evidence of distinct value, not just a name on this list).

operationalConstraints: Never invent reviews, testimonials, customer names, jobs performed, or locations where jobs were performed.
Never invent or imply pricing beyond the published priceRange ($100-$600) without explicit business authorization.
Never invent licenses, certifications, awards, partnerships, or business statistics.
Never invent local regulations, recycling rules, disposal rules, or municipal program details — only cite verifiable official sources.
Treat competitor content as landscape observation only — never authoritative, never copied.
A claimed service area (JSON-LD areaServed) is not itself permission to create a page — new pages need their own evidence of distinct visitor value.
